lernapps.github.io.message:
fix(home): role prompts ask the assistant to look at the catalogue

## Intent

In the live test, assistants read "I find suitable apps myself in the catalogue" as "do not look". They skipped the catalogue and named apps from older pages instead. The prompts should ask them to look at the catalogue.

## Key changes

- The teacher, parent and learner prompts say "Wirf auch einen Blick in den Katalog" ("Also have a look at the catalogue"), with its address, in German and English.
